en: The postcard features a picturesque scene of a bridge over a canal or river, with a wooden footbridge crossing above it. There is a tall, medieval stone tower (Torre Vanga) with crenellated top in the background and some classical styled buildings, possibly residential or public, nearby. The area is lush and green with trees and grass along the banks, and cows drinking from the water at the bottom left. The top of the postcard has the printed text 'Trento, Passerella e Torre Vanga.'
